description.en: Per-turn skill-usage audit: a strip above the composer, a sidebar glyph and a centre panel report which skills each turn invoked (loaded by the model or typed as /name) or that it invoked none. Also manages the local skill directory: install from a pasted repository, folder, SKILL.md or zip address, write a Chinese display name into the skill's meta.yaml, and remove a skill while keeping a backup.
description.zh: 每轮对话的 skill 调用审计：输入框上方横栏、左栏图标与中栏面板报告本轮用到了哪些 skill（模型自动加载或用户 /name 调用），或一个都没用。同时管理本机 skill 目录：粘贴仓库、文件夹、SKILL.md 或 zip 地址即可安装，中文显示名写入该 skill 的 meta.yaml，删除时保留备份。
